name: BAAI/AREX-2 model card
notes: Fetched 2026-11-26. HF repo BAAI/AREX-2, created 2026-09-29 (API createdAt), licence apache-2.0 (YAML frontmatter and LICENSE file), base_model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B with no base_model_relation tag. safetensors total 27,356,728,560 BF16 (single precision). Tags: transformers, safetensors, qwen3_5, image-text-to-text, agent, deep-research, reasoning, tool-use, long-context, self-improvement. Paper arXiv 2609.38288 ('AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks'), code github.com/VectorSpaceLab/AREX-2. Card publishes two HTML benchmark tables (no markdown tables, no embedded benchmark figures beyond the logo): 'Coding and machine-learning engineering' (Frontier-CS, MLE-Lite) and 'General agentic reasoning and deep research' (BrowseComp, HLE, GAIA, DeepSearchQA). NEITHER table prints a Qwen3.8-27B base row, so the card supplies NO base-vs-tuned delta - the headline claims are phrased as 'turns extra test-time rounds into useful solution refinement' with no ablation shown. Card does print its group headers ('Closed-weight models', 'Open-weight models', 'Frontier models', 'Large models (>40B)', 'Small models (<=40B)'), so the AREX-2 row sits inside the <=40B group in table 2 and the open-weight group in table 1. Metric definitions are thin: only two footnotes exist, 'Frontier-CS is the 188-task Agent Track' and 'MLE-Lite reports Any Medal averaged over three seeds'. No harness, no temperature, no repetition count for the DeepSearchQA / GAIA / BrowseComp / HLE columns.
